panels.scene: Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. Wide street-level view of Franz Dick, a 35-year-old adult man with short sandy hair, a narrow face, a small neat moustache, a faded slate-blue cloak and a worn brown vest cornered beside harbor warehouses. Two massive adult dock guards in thick leather coats stand in front of him with drawn short swords. Ship masts rise beyond them. Franz tries to appear confident; neither guard is amused.
panels.caption: В порту разговор зашёл слишком далеко.

panels.scene: Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. Medium close-up of Franz straightening his faded blue cloak and raising one imperious finger. The two armed guards exchange weary glances. His own weapon remains sheathed.

dialogue.speaker: Франц
dialogue.text: Я шериф этого города. Разыскиваю свою сестру Марго.

panels.scene: Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. Dynamic diagonal view: one guard thrusts his short sword forward; Franz twists his narrow torso aside just in time, cloak flaring. The sword misses him. No injury, no blood.
panels.caption: Первый удар прошёл мимо.

panels.scene: Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. Low-angle shot of Franz turning sharply to sprint along the quay, brown boots splashing through shallow puddles. A guard swings behind him and misses the trailing cloak.

dialogue.speaker: Франц
dialogue.text: Это не бегство. Это тактический манёвр!

panels.scene: Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. The two heavy guards remain beside the warehouse rather than pursuing. One points his sword after the fleeing Franz; sailors pause by barrels to watch.

dialogue.speaker: Охранник
dialogue.text: Ещё раз увидим тебя здесь — пожалеешь!

panels.scene: Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. Long view down the waterfront: Franz runs toward the street away from the port, looking over one shoulder and raising a defiant hand. Background sailors grin. His escape is successful.

Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. Jack, an adult man with tousled dark hair, stubble, a weathered brown leather coat and a burgundy scarf and Pippin, an adult female halfling with curly bright copper hair, a round expressive face, a green travelling cloak, cream blouse and brown leather bodice load wrapped food and a wine jug onto their modest wooden cart outside Godfrey’s tavern. Their ordinary working horse waits patiently beside a stable worker.
panels.caption: У Годфри готовили заказ начальнику порта.

dialogue.speaker: Конюх
dialogue.text: За лошадь — два медяка в день.

panels.scene: Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. Jack strokes the horse’s nose while holding his almost empty purse. Pippin sits on the cart bench, observing him with skeptical amusement. Healthy hay protrudes from the horse’s feed rack.

dialogue.speaker: Джек
dialogue.text: Два медных в день. При моём заработке — ноль.

panels.scene: Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. Evening harbor exterior. The modest cart pulls up near an ornate port office. A magnificent enclosed carriage drawn by four large well-groomed horses is visible nearby, with a composed uniformed coachman seated high above.
panels.caption: У конторы уже стояла чужая карета.

panels.scene: Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. Warm interior at the port master’s doorway. Jack carries the parcel and wine; Pippin stands beside him. The older heavyset port master in a rich burgundy robe eagerly takes the provisions.

dialogue.speaker: Начальник порта
dialogue.text: Наконец-то! Вас хоть за смертью посылай.

panels.scene: Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. The port master eats hungrily behind his cluttered wooden desk while Jack and Pippin remain standing near the door. The master gestures toward them with a morsel but does not invite them to sit.

dialogue.speaker: Начальник порта
dialogue.text: К пиру не приглашаю. А насчёт корабля надумали?

panels.scene: Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. Port master points through the tall office window toward the masts in the harbor. Jack and Pippin exchange a determined look. No elven vessel has arrived yet.

dialogue.speaker: Начальник порта
dialogue.text: Увидите эльфийский корабль — значит, пора. Ждите в ближайшую неделю.

panels.scene: Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. Jack, an adult man with tousled dark hair, stubble, a weathered brown leather coat and a burgundy scarf gazes admiringly at the grand black-and-gold inquisitorial carriage and its four powerful horses. Pippin, an adult female halfling with curly bright copper hair, a round expressive face, a green travelling cloak, cream blouse and brown leather bodice stops several paces behind him, wary of the severe religious insignia on the carriage.

Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. Jack stands below the coachman’s high seat, hatless and hopeful. The adult coachman wears a sober dark uniform and gloves, with a pipe resting in one hand. Show the height difference clearly.

dialogue.speaker: Джек
dialogue.text: Я тоже извозчик. Как к вам устроиться?

panels.scene: Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. Close view of the coachman calmly counting the stages of a career on gloved fingers; Jack listens with exaggerated concentration beside the wheel.

dialogue.speaker: Кучер
dialogue.text: Школа в Альтдорфе. Затем инквизиторий. А дальше — назначение.

panels.scene: Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. Jack speaks a little too freely, making a careless gesture toward an imagined past encounter. The coachman leans forward, suddenly interested. The mood turns tense without weapons being drawn.

dialogue.speaker: Джек
dialogue.text: Я тоже видел культистов. Заглянул не в ту дверь…

panels.scene: Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. Jack hurriedly explains himself with open hands. The coachman remains seated and unconvinced but does not restrain him. A warm carriage lantern illuminates their faces.

dialogue.speaker: Кучер
dialogue.text: Учиться тебе следовало лет двадцать пять назад.

panels.scene: Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. Jack returns with slumped shoulders to his shabby cart, where Pippin is waiting on the bench. The luxurious carriage recedes behind them. Her questioning expression contrasts with his defeated stare.

Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. the female archivist, a young adult with pinned-up light brown hair, round spectacles and a dark navy cloak with fur trim locks her tiny port-office room and joins Jack, an adult man with tousled dark hair, stubble, a weathered brown leather coat and a burgundy scarf and Pippin, an adult female halfling with curly bright copper hair, a round expressive face, a green travelling cloak, cream blouse and brown leather bodice at their cart after sunset. She carries a document case and looks energized by a new idea.
panels.caption: Рабочий день давно закончился.

panels.scene: Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. Three-quarter view from inside the moving cart. Jack drives; the archivist turns toward Pippin and gestures as if framing a picture. Pippin holds a small case of colored pencils. No finished advertisement yet.

dialogue.speaker: Архивариус
dialogue.text: Нарисуем объявление: пишу письма и документы.

panels.scene: Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. Close two-shot of the archivist explaining her idea and Pippin beginning to understand. Colored pencils catch the last warm lantern light against blue twilight.

dialogue.speaker: Архивариус
dialogue.text: Те, кому я нужна, читать не умеют. Пусть поймут по картинке.

panels.scene: Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. Wide atmospheric view of their cart passing the harbor warehouses. Several distant dock workers gather and look uneasy. An empty barrel stands where a familiar watcher used to sit. The travelers continue on their way.
panels.caption: У складов беспокоились люди. Знакомое место на бочках пустовало.

panels.scene: Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. Cut to an upstairs tavern bedroom: Doctor Popov, an elderly man with swept-back gray hair, a short gray beard, wire spectacles and a dark green coat over a waistcoat sorts carefully labelled medicine bottles, paper packets and stoppered jars into groups on a small wooden table. An open wooden crate sits beside him. No one consumes any medicine.
panels.caption: А Попов разбирал привезённые лекарства.

panels.scene: Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. Doctor Popov pushes the closed crate safely beneath his bed, then sits on the bed with a satisfied, tired smile. A single candle glows beside his folded green coat.

Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. Franz Dick, a 35-year-old adult man with short sandy hair, a narrow face, a small neat moustache, a faded slate-blue cloak and a worn brown vest enters a tasteful candlelit establishment in the middle-class district. A polished wooden bar, incense burner and fully clothed adult patrons suggest a discreet social salon. He suddenly remembers the portrait tucked inside his cloak.
panels.caption: Франц вспомнил о расследовании.

panels.scene: Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. Close-up of Franz confidently sliding a single small copper coin across the polished bar with one finger. The neatly dressed bartender looks down at it without enthusiasm.

Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. The bartender holds up a silver coin at eye level. Franz’s self-confident smile fades. His copper coin still lies on the counter between them.

dialogue.speaker: Бармен
dialogue.text: Мы привыкли, что деньги выглядят вот так.

panels.scene: Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. Franz sits apart on a bar stool, listening to quiet conversations between elegantly dressed adults. No one pays him much attention. His shabby blue cloak stands out among their clean clothes.
panels.caption: Слухи оказались чужими и бесполезными.

panels.scene: Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. Later in a quiet sitting area, Franz shows a folded wanted portrait of a broad-faced bearded man to a fully clothed adult female attendant. She studies it and shakes her head. No nudity, no bed, no sexual action.

dialogue.speaker: Франц
dialogue.text: Это Генри. Мой знакомый. Не знаешь, где он?

panels.scene: Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. Franz emerges alone into an almost deserted Gothic street beneath the greenish light of Morrslieb. He folds the portrait carefully and pulls his faded slate-blue cloak around his shoulders.
panels.caption: Серебро ушло. Следа Генри не прибавилось.

panels.scene: Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. Franz Dick, a 35-year-old adult man with short sandy hair, a narrow face, a small neat moustache, a faded slate-blue cloak and a worn brown vest dramatically drops a room key onto the desk of an elderly female lodging-house caretaker. She sits wrapped in a shawl beneath a dim oil lamp and accepts it with total indifference.

Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. Exterior at night: Franz stands before the massive closed wooden doors of Sigmar’s temple. A sleepy novice peers through a narrow opening between the doors. Green moonlight washes over the stone steps.

dialogue.speaker: Послушник
dialogue.text: До молитвы посторонних не пускаем. Культы не дремлют.

panels.scene: Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. Back at the lodging-house desk, Franz attempts a coin-behind-the-ear trick beside the elderly caretaker. His outstretched hand returns empty; she looks unimpressed and holds her palm out for payment.

Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. Franz arrives at the dark closed office where he distributes handbills. A faded bundle of paper notices is visible through a shuttered window. He tests the locked door and searches for an open window, finding none.
panels.caption: Контора тоже была заперта. Ключей не было.

panels.scene: Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. Tight non-graphic close-up of Franz attempting to pick the old door lock with his fingernail. He recoils, clutching one injured finger in his other hand; only a tiny red mark, no exposed tissue. His mouth stays shut despite the pain.

Painterly realistic dark-fantasy comic, weathered Gothic port city, warm candlelight versus cool blue exterior light, natural expressive faces, no modern objects. Franz stands at a nighttime street junction, wrapping his sore finger in a small cloth. Downhill, sparse harbor lanterns reveal the direction of cheap lodging houses. He looks toward them with reluctant resignation.

dialogue.speaker: Франц
dialogue.text: Но мне же нельзя в порт!

panels.scene: Establishing wide shot inside Godfrey’s gothic port tavern at dusk. Jack, adult man with messy dark hair, stubble, worn brown coat and red scarf, sits beside Pippin, adult female halfling with curly copper hair and green cloak, and the female Archivist, brown hair pinned up, round glasses, fur-trimmed navy cloak. Old ragged fiddler in background, candlelit wooden table.
panels.caption: К вечеру трое вернулись из порта.

panels.scene: Close view of Jack’s reluctant hand counting a few copper coins on the dinner table. A halfling waiter carries bowls of stew. Jack wears a worried, hungry expression.
panels.caption: Ужин снова съедал последние медяки.

dialogue.speaker: Архивариус
dialogue.text: Джек, есть предложение. Заодно заработаешь на обед.

panels.scene: Archivist leans forward confidently, touching her quill and blank parchment. Jack listens over his bowl. Warm candlelight catches her round glasses.

dialogue.speaker: Архивариус
dialogue.text: Людям нужны письма и документы. Читать они не умеют. А я умею.

panels.scene: Pippin sketches a little workman giving coins to a woman with a quill on parchment. The Archivist points out details; Jack gestures toward the tavern crowd.

dialogue.speaker: Архивариус
dialogue.text: Пиппин нарисует объявление. Ты приведёшь клиентов — получишь долю.

panels.scene: Jack raises one finger with mock seriousness, trying to look discreet. Archivist studies him with a dry smile; Pippin grins.
Cutaway comic wide shot of their parked rough wooden cart outside the tavern, with two empty closed coffins sitting inside like absurd benches. Horse rests by a lantern; no bodies or gore.
panels.caption: Телегу тоже предлагали пустить в дело.

panels.scene: Inside the women’s modest upstairs tavern room, Archivist firmly closes the timber door. Jack sits on a stool, Pippin on a low bed. One candle, travel bags and drawing paper. All fully dressed, serious private discussion.
panels.caption: После ужина Архивариус закрыла дверь.

dialogue.speaker: Архивариус
dialogue.text: Интересы Годфри и Инквизиции пересеклись на Наместнике.

panels.scene: Medium shot of Archivist speaking quietly through round spectacles. A dark window frames gothic rooftops; Jack leans forward, suddenly alert.
panels.caption: Пока это были лишь подозрения.

dialogue.speaker: Архивариус
dialogue.text: Возможно, дело не только во взятках.

panels.scene: Jack springs upright with excited eyes, one hand already reaching for his belt. Pippin looks amused while Archivist stops him with a raised palm.

dialogue.speaker: Джек
dialogue.text: Я в деле! Пиппин, нужны верёвки.

dialogue.speaker: Архивариус
dialogue.text: Нужны доказательства. Сами мы его не одолеем.

panels.scene: Top view of a small desk with a crude port map and blank papers. Archivist’s finger indicates the docks; Jack and Pippin listen. Do not show fabricated readable records.

dialogue.speaker: Архивариус
dialogue.text: Я проверю портовые бумаги. Соберём улики — передадим Инквизиции.

panels.scene: Pippin proudly holds up her simple illustrated advertisement showing a worker, coins, a female scribe and a letter. Archivist smiles and prepares decorative stationery. Jack watches them, impatience returning.
panels.caption: На полезные дела тоже назначили цену.

panels.scene: Jack stands at the tavern counter facing Godfrey, a broad older dwarf innkeeper with a bald crown, thick grey beard and leather apron. Godfrey polishes a spotless axe with a cloth. Lamplight, empty mugs, stern expression.
panels.caption: Джек спустился прямо к Годфри.

dialogue.speaker: Джек
dialogue.text: Две верёвки и две лампы. Для серьёзного дела.

panels.scene: Godfrey rests both hands on the counter, regarding Jack skeptically. Jack outlines an ambitious plan with sweeping gestures and eager grin.

dialogue.speaker: Годфри
dialogue.text: За неделю результата не показали. Уже штурмом?

panels.scene: Tight portrait of Godfrey, sombre rather than comic, with axe held safely down on the counter. Jack’s enthusiasm fades. No execution or hanging shown.

dialogue.speaker: Годфри
dialogue.text: Одного помощника я дал. Теперь он у храма висит. Сначала покажите результат.

panels.scene: Godfrey points past Jack through the open tavern door toward market stalls in the darkening street. Jack stands with his hat in hand, defeated.

dialogue.speaker: Годфри
dialogue.text: На улице. По обе стороны дороги. Всё за деньги.

panels.scene: Night. Jack cautiously peers through the door into Doctor Popov’s bedroom. The elderly grey-bearded doctor in spectacles sleeps under a blanket, green coat hanging beside the bed. Candle illuminates ordinary furniture; no supernatural shadow present.
panels.caption: В комнате доктора теней не оказалось.

panels.scene: Morning breakfast at tavern table. Cheerful elderly Doctor Popov with grey beard, round glasses and green coat reaches toward Jack’s forehead as if checking a fever. Jack looks earnest. Pippin and Archivist sit opposite.
panels.caption: Утром Попов выспался лучше остальных.

dialogue.speaker: Попов
dialogue.text: Жара нет. План всё равно самоубийственный.

panels.scene: Jack hunches closer and whispers to the group, glancing toward Godfrey at the distant bar. Pippin nods to confirm seeing something.

dialogue.speaker: Джек
dialogue.text: Мы видели, как Марк вошёл в поместье. Возможно, он переметнулся.

panels.scene: Doctor Popov counts factions on his fingers with an ironic look. Archivist sits composed behind spectacles. Jack appears uneasy.

dialogue.speaker: Попов
dialogue.text: Архивариус — с Инквизицией. Марк — с Наместником. Весёлая компания.

panels.scene: Popov speaks quietly across the table, one closed empty pouch beside his breakfast. Only conversational faces; no chemicals, recipes, well contamination, or preparation imagery.
panels.caption: Доктор признался в своём замысле.

dialogue.speaker: Попов
dialogue.text: Я хотел устроить переполох в богатом квартале. Чтобы Инквизиция вмешалась.

panels.scene: Popov indicates the countryside beyond the window with an open hand. Jack listens while Pippin checks her travel cloak. On table only breakfast bowls and rolled parchment.

dialogue.speaker: Попов
dialogue.text: Сначала съездим за ягодами. Потом — сведения.

panels.scene: Wide morning gothic street. Group walks on foot and separates at an intersection: Archivist and Pippin head toward residential bathhouse lane, Jack and Popov toward a distant Sigmar temple. No cart with them.
panels.caption: Дамы пошли в баню. Мужчины — к храму Сигмара.

panels.scene: Morning in crowded cheap boardinghouse, rough beds and washbasin. Franz is a distinct adult man aged 35 with short sandy hair, narrow face, small neat moustache, faded slate-blue cloak over brown vest. He sits fully clothed holding an unpleasantly dirty small coin pouch away from himself. Keep bodily functions offscreen.
panels.caption: Франц вернулся к хозяйке и заплатил девять пенни. Утром деньги были на месте.

dialogue.speaker: Франц
dialogue.text: Все монеты на месте. Вот только мешочек…

panels.scene: Franz outside in a cobbled lane awkwardly rinses coins with a little water from a cup, looking frustrated. Fully clothed, no explicit bodily imagery. Moustache and slate-blue cloak clearly distinguish him from Jack.
panels.caption: Отмыть сбережения толком не получилось.

panels.scene: Establishing interior of a medieval banking office. Guards beside the doorway, clerks behind iron grilles, annoyed customers with parchment forms. Franz approaches a free counter. Gothic timber and stone, cool daylight.
panels.caption: В конторе спорили о справках и очередях.

panels.scene: Weary bank clerk slides a sheaf of parchment toward Franz through the grille. Franz firmly rejects another proposal with a raised palm.
Close view of five silver coins placed in a small wooden lockbox. Clerk closes its lid with one key and hands the duplicate to Franz alongside a document.

dialogue.speaker: Клерк
dialogue.text: Забирать раз в неделю. По предварительной записи.

panels.scene: Clerk leans back with a subtly disgusted expression, holding the closed lockbox away. Franz pockets his key with a proud, untroubled smile. No visible filth detail.
Franz in slate-blue cloak offers an ordinary worn dagger to a muscular blacksmith at a forge. Blacksmith points toward a rack of many similar blades with a dismissive look.
panels.caption: Сбережения лежали в банке. Теперь хотелось заработать.

dialogue.speaker: Кузнец
dialogue.text: Такого железа у меня целая пачка.

panels.scene: At a second-hand dealer’s stall, Franz bargains animatedly over his dagger and removed brown leather vest, now wearing shirt under slate-blue cloak. Dealer counts silver and copper coins.
panels.caption: Скупщик взял кинжал и жилетку. Денег стало больше, защиты — меньше.

panels.scene: Franz discreetly shows a wanted portrait to the honest second-hand dealer while placing five copper coins near the counter. Merchant refuses with folded arms.

dialogue.speaker: Франц
dialogue.text: А запрещённый товар? За пять медяков?

panels.scene: Franz pauses outside a woodcarver’s shop, overhearing two adult men talking among carved boxes and furniture. He keeps to the doorframe, alert.
panels.caption: Зато у резчика разговор был совсем другой.

dialogue.speaker: Голос из лавки
dialogue.text: Богатый квартал обносят. Я скупаю — потом перепродаю.

panels.scene: Franz enters the woodcarver’s shop trying to appear casually criminal, one hand on his hip. Two suspicious craftsmen turn to assess his worn cloak.

dialogue.speaker: Франц
dialogue.text: У меня друг со шрамом. Намечается дело. Десять золотых выгоды!

panels.scene: The two woodcarvers stand shoulder to shoulder with identical guarded expressions, blocking further conversation. Franz’s hopeful smile collapses as he heads back to the open door.
panels.caption: Доверия купить не удалось.

panels.scene: Wide interior of a gothic Sigmar temple at morning, candlelight and cold stained-glass beams. Jack, adult man with tousled dark hair, stubble, brown leather coat, burgundy scarf leads Doctor Popov, elderly grey-haired man with trimmed grey beard, round glasses, dark green coat and medical satchel, matching the previous comic issues through kneeling worshippers.
panels.caption: Утро. Перед поездкой за город Джек и доктор зашли в храм Сигмара.

panels.scene: Jack, adult man with tousled dark hair, stubble, brown leather coat, burgundy scarf kneels before the altar, hands clasped, eyes raised toward a monumental hammer-bearing statue.

dialogue.speaker: Джек
dialogue.text: Дай мне силы на сегодняшний день, Сигмар.

panels.scene: Outside the temple entrance, Doctor Popov, elderly grey-haired man with trimmed grey beard, round glasses, dark green coat and medical satchel, matching the previous comic issues quietly questions Volkmar, stern bald middle-aged Sigmarite priest with a small comet tattoo on his forehead, heavy dark robes and metal religious pendant. Worshippers pass in the background.

dialogue.speaker: Попов
dialogue.text: Что произошло в лечебнице? Там мои коллеги и пациенты.

panels.scene: Close-up of Volkmar, stern bald middle-aged Sigmarite priest with a small comet tattoo on his forehead, heavy dark robes and metal religious pendant, stern expression, raised palm, temple doors behind him.

dialogue.speaker: Фолькмар
dialogue.text: Это закрытая информация. Странно, что к тебе ещё не пришли.

panels.scene: Doctor Popov, elderly grey-haired man with trimmed grey beard, round glasses, dark green coat and medical satchel, matching the previous comic issues stands thoughtfully on the steps. Jack, adult man with tousled dark hair, stubble, brown leather coat, burgundy scarf exits the temple after prayer and joins him.
panels.caption: Фолькмар ничего не объяснил. За ответами придётся идти дальше.

panels.scene: A modest bathhouse lobby full of steam. the adult female archivist, slim, light-brown hair pinned up, small round spectacles, dark navy high-collared robe with fur trim and Pippin, an adult female halfling, very short and sturdy, curly copper-red hair, expressive freckled face, green travelling cloak over cream blouse and brown leather vest wear fully closed high-neck bathing robes over their clothes; all bodies completely covered. The archivist wipes foggy spectacles. No nudity.

In the bathhouse corridor, a stern adult woman in a fully closed dark robe leans down to whisper to Pippin, an adult female halfling, very short and sturdy, curly copper-red hair, expressive freckled face, green travelling cloak over cream blouse and brown leather vest, who freezes. the adult female archivist, slim, light-brown hair pinned up, small round spectacles, dark navy high-collared robe with fur trim is a few steps away, still wiping glasses. No nudity.

dialogue.speaker: Пиппин
dialogue.text: Мы ведь так и не выполнили её заказ…

panels.scene: Outside the bathhouse, Pippin, an adult female halfling, very short and sturdy, curly copper-red hair, expressive freckled face, green travelling cloak over cream blouse and brown leather vest and the adult female archivist, slim, light-brown hair pinned up, small round spectacles, dark navy high-collared robe with fur trim, now in their normal fully dressed travelling outfits, hurry toward the gothic temple.
panels.caption: Архивариус проводила Пиппин к храму и ушла работать. Но страх после бани никуда не исчез.

panels.scene: Pippin, an adult female halfling, very short and sturdy, curly copper-red hair, expressive freckled face, green travelling cloak over cream blouse and brown leather vest kneels at the temple altar, then looks over her shoulder at two threatening adult men standing in the distant entrance.

Volkmar, stern bald middle-aged Sigmarite priest with a small comet tattoo on his forehead, heavy dark robes and metal religious pendant looks toward the now empty entrance while Pippin, an adult female halfling, very short and sturdy, curly copper-red hair, expressive freckled face, green travelling cloak over cream blouse and brown leather vest points nervously toward it.

dialogue.speaker: Фолькмар
dialogue.text: Обратитесь в жандармерию. Здесь никого нет.

panels.scene: Pippin, an adult female halfling, very short and sturdy, curly copper-red hair, expressive freckled face, green travelling cloak over cream blouse and brown leather vest remains inside the temple, cautiously peering around the massive doorframe at the empty street.

Franz, an adult man aged 35 with short sandy hair, narrow face, small neat moustache, faded slate-blue cloak and plain ivory linen shirt; clearly distinct from Jack walks onto a busy stone quay toward an ornate sailing ship. Its gangplank is raised and there is no waiting queue.
panels.caption: Франц вернулся в порт. У красивого корабля очередь исчезла, а трап был поднят.

panels.scene: Franz, an adult man aged 35 with short sandy hair, narrow face, small neat moustache, faded slate-blue cloak and plain ivory linen shirt; clearly distinct from Jack stops a passing dockworker carrying a small crate and points at the ship.

dialogue.speaker: Франц
dialogue.text: Где команда? Я хочу поговорить с капитаном.

panels.scene: Franz, an adult man aged 35 with short sandy hair, narrow face, small neat moustache, faded slate-blue cloak and plain ivory linen shirt; clearly distinct from Jack stands at the stern end of the quay, holding a tiny pebble and studying the carved stern cabin windows high above.
Close view of a tiny pebble striking a murky stern window, a clear star-shaped crack forming in the glass. Dramatic diagonal composition.
panels.caption: Маленький камешек оказался гораздо убедительнее, чем хотелось.

panels.scene: the angry shipowner, middle-aged heavyset man with a broad weathered face, dark burgundy merchant caftan, rings, flanked by a towering bald bodyguard leans angrily over the ship rail while sailors rush to lower the gangplank.

dialogue.speaker: Судовладелец
dialogue.text: Два серебряных тому, кто его поймает!

panels.scene: Franz, an adult man aged 35 with short sandy hair, narrow face, small neat moustache, faded slate-blue cloak and plain ivory linen shirt; clearly distinct from Jack runs along the quay into an approaching crowd of eager sailors, raising one hand in desperate bargaining.

dialogue.speaker: Франц
dialogue.text: А я плачу три — за него!

panels.scene: A crowd of sailors restrains Franz, an adult man aged 35 with short sandy hair, narrow face, small neat moustache, faded slate-blue cloak and plain ivory linen shirt; clearly distinct from Jack on the stone quay; his slate-blue cloak and plain ivory linen shirt are pulled away, leaving him in an opaque long linen shirt and trousers. the angry shipowner, middle-aged heavyset man with a broad weathered face, dark burgundy merchant caftan, rings, flanked by a towering bald bodyguard approaches. No nudity.
panels.caption: Матросы оказались быстрее. Деньги, документы и ключ от ячейки забрали.

panels.scene: Franz sits on a shipping crate in a fully opaque linen shirt and trousers, looking hopefully at the angry shipowner, middle-aged heavyset man with a broad weathered face, dark burgundy merchant caftan, rings, flanked by a towering bald bodyguard.

dialogue.speaker: Франц
dialogue.text: Я отличный гребец. Хочу устроиться к вам.

panels.scene: Close composition: the angry shipowner, middle-aged heavyset man with a broad weathered face, dark burgundy merchant caftan, rings, flanked by a towering bald bodyguard leans toward seated Franz, holding ten fingers apart only as a forceful conversational gesture. Bodyguard looms behind.

the adult female archivist, slim, light-brown hair pinned up, small round spectacles, dark navy high-collared robe with fur trim looks through the crowd, recognizes Franz on the crate, and addresses a nearby sailor.

dialogue.speaker: Архивариус
dialogue.text: А вы знаете, что он госслужащий?

panels.scene: A restrained silhouetted view of the bodyguard grabbing Franz at the quay edge; a knife is only a small distant glint, no visible wound or gore. The shipowner gestures toward the river.
panels.caption: После этих слов разговор закончился.

panels.scene: Franz falls from the quay into dark river water, fully clothed in his linen shirt and trousers; dramatic splash, abandoned pebble in the foreground. No gore.
panels.caption: Он ещё жив. Но сознание уходит, а берег остаётся наверху.

panels.scene: the adult female archivist, slim, light-brown hair pinned up, small round spectacles, dark navy high-collared robe with fur trim slowly wipes her spectacles while the dock crowd disperses. The shipowner and bodyguard depart toward the ship carrying Franz’s slate-blue cloak, plain ivory linen shirt and boots.
panels.caption: Толпа разошлась. Архивариус заметила у здоровяка знакомые вещи.

panels.scene: the adult female archivist, slim, light-brown hair pinned up, small round spectacles, dark navy high-collared robe with fur trim catches up to the angry shipowner, middle-aged heavyset man with a broad weathered face, dark burgundy merchant caftan, rings, flanked by a towering bald bodyguard beside the gangplank and points politely toward the bundle of clothing.

dialogue.speaker: Архивариус
dialogue.text: Можно я заберу одежду несчастного пловца?

panels.scene: the adult female archivist, slim, light-brown hair pinned up, small round spectacles, dark navy high-collared robe with fur trim now holds the bundle of Franz’s clothes under one arm, smiling professionally as she starts to leave.

dialogue.speaker: Архивариус
dialogue.text: Понадобятся услуги писца — заглядывайте в канцелярию порта.

panels.scene: the angry shipowner, middle-aged heavyset man with a broad weathered face, dark burgundy merchant caftan, rings, flanked by a towering bald bodyguard abruptly turns back and extends a commanding hand toward the archivist.

dialogue.speaker: Судовладелец
dialogue.text: Так это ты новая сотрудница? Садись. Обсудим кое-что.

panels.scene: Two sailors block the adult female archivist, slim, light-brown hair pinned up, small round spectacles, dark navy high-collared robe with fur trim as she tries to stride away with the clothes; she lifts one finger indignantly.

dialogue.speaker: Архивариус
dialogue.text: Я на вас жалобу напишу! В отличие от вас я могу писать.

panels.scene: the adult female archivist, slim, light-brown hair pinned up, small round spectacles, dark navy high-collared robe with fur trim sits stiffly on the same shipping crate previously occupied by Franz, the clothing bundle on her lap. the angry shipowner, middle-aged heavyset man with a broad weathered face, dark burgundy merchant caftan, rings, flanked by a towering bald bodyguard sits opposite.
panels.caption: Рабочий день начинался совсем не в канцелярии.

panels.scene: the angry shipowner, middle-aged heavyset man with a broad weathered face, dark burgundy merchant caftan, rings, flanked by a towering bald bodyguard speaks quietly across the crates to the adult female archivist, slim, light-brown hair pinned up, small round spectacles, dark navy high-collared robe with fur trim, a coin in one hand, the other hand resting near a sheathed dagger.

dialogue.speaker: Судовладелец
dialogue.text: Не замечаешь — получаешь деньги. Замечаешь — получаешь нож.

panels.scene: the adult female archivist, slim, light-brown hair pinned up, small round spectacles, dark navy high-collared robe with fur trim removes her round spectacles and looks straight past the merchant with a perfectly composed face.
Over the merchant’s shoulder, several sailing ships and a warehouse clerk at a crate desk. His pointing hand connects the vessels and the paperwork.
panels.caption: Нужно было пропускать нужные корабли и убрать бумаги о поставке из Лустрии.

panels.scene: the angry shipowner, middle-aged heavyset man with a broad weathered face, dark burgundy merchant caftan, rings, flanked by a towering bald bodyguard leans in, now more serious. the adult female archivist, slim, light-brown hair pinned up, small round spectacles, dark navy high-collared robe with fur trim listens while holding her spectacles by one temple.

dialogue.speaker: Судовладелец
dialogue.text: Предыдущий канцелярист пропал. Из-за него сорвалась поставка.

panels.scene: the adult female archivist, slim, light-brown hair pinned up, small round spectacles, dark navy high-collared robe with fur trim calmly extends an open palm. the angry shipowner, middle-aged heavyset man with a broad weathered face, dark burgundy merchant caftan, rings, flanked by a towering bald bodyguard grudgingly counts a small pile of silver coins into it.

the adult female archivist, slim, light-brown hair pinned up, small round spectacles, dark navy high-collared robe with fur trim walks into the port office carrying the clothes and purse; stacked documents and an unoccupied writing desk await her.
panels.caption: Объявление она пока не вывесила. Сначала — разобраться в старых бумагах.

panels.scene: Jack, adult man with tousled dark hair, stubble, brown leather coat, burgundy scarf drives a wooden cart loaded with closed wooden coffins along a country lane. Doctor Popov, elderly grey-haired man with trimmed grey beard, round glasses, dark green coat and medical satchel, matching the previous comic issues sits beside him. City walls recede behind them.
panels.caption: За городом Джек и Попов добрались до знакомого места без приключений.

panels.scene: Doctor Popov, elderly grey-haired man with trimmed grey beard, round glasses, dark green coat and medical satchel, matching the previous comic issues holds one strange dark berry as a visual example while Jack, adult man with tousled dark hair, stubble, brown leather coat, burgundy scarf looks at scrubby bushes.

dialogue.speaker: Попов
dialogue.text: Нужны вот такие. Только не ешь их.

panels.scene: Doctor Popov, elderly grey-haired man with trimmed grey beard, round glasses, dark green coat and medical satchel, matching the previous comic issues crouches by bare bushes and examines empty branches, looking disappointed.
panels.caption: На старых кустах ничего не осталось.

panels.scene: Jack, adult man with tousled dark hair, stubble, brown leather coat, burgundy scarf approaches with his coat gathered into a pouch full of assorted berries and leaves. Doctor Popov, elderly grey-haired man with trimmed grey beard, round glasses, dark green coat and medical satchel, matching the previous comic issues looks up, astonished.

Inside the cart, an empty open wooden coffin is used as a sorting tray for mixed berries and leaves. Doctor Popov, elderly grey-haired man with trimmed grey beard, round glasses, dark green coat and medical satchel, matching the previous comic issues selects nine berries into his palm; small closed fantasy supply pouches lie beside him. No manufacturing process.
panels.caption: Из всей охапки нашлось девять нужных ягод.

panels.scene: Jack, adult man with tousled dark hair, stubble, brown leather coat, burgundy scarf takes the reins again as Doctor Popov, elderly grey-haired man with trimmed grey beard, round glasses, dark green coat and medical satchel, matching the previous comic issues settles among the cargo with a satisfied smile.

dialogue.speaker: Джек
dialogue.text: Меня больше интересует вторая часть плана.

panels.scene: The cart rolls back toward the distant gothic city. Jack, adult man with tousled dark hair, stubble, brown leather coat, burgundy scarf talks to Doctor Popov, elderly grey-haired man with trimmed grey beard, round glasses, dark green coat and medical satchel, matching the previous comic issues; both remain fully dressed as established.

dialogue.speaker: Джек
dialogue.text: Сначала переоденемся. Потом дадим архивариусу знак.

panels.scene: Doctor Popov, elderly grey-haired man with trimmed grey beard, round glasses, dark green coat and medical satchel, matching the previous comic issues looks skeptically at Jack, adult man with tousled dark hair, stubble, brown leather coat, burgundy scarf over his spectacles, one hand resting on a closed medical satchel.
Both men suddenly pause and turn toward the empty space beside them on the cart. Warm late-afternoon light.

Pippin, an adult female halfling, very short and sturdy, curly copper-red hair, expressive freckled face, green travelling cloak over cream blouse and brown leather vest stands inside the massive temple doorway at sunset, looking down the empty street. Small candles burn behind her.
panels.caption: Пиппин всё ещё ждала. Солнце опускалось, друзья не появлялись.

panels.scene: Pippin, an adult female halfling, very short and sturdy, curly copper-red hair, expressive freckled face, green travelling cloak over cream blouse and brown leather vest kneels fiercely at the temple altar, clasping her hands with restrained anger instead of peace.

Wide final image of the river Aver at twilight below the gothic port. Franz floats unconscious in his opaque linen shirt and trousers, small against the dark water. No rescuer, no confirmed death, no gore.
panels.caption: Авер уносила Франца. Что будет с ним дальше — пока неизвестно. Продолжение следует.
